# Vendored: @embabel/appliance-ui

Do not edit. Source of truth:
`embabel-appliance-client/packages/appliance-ui/css`.

Vendored rather than installed, exactly like `marked` and `purify` next door:
the renderer has no bundler and no module system, and the packaged app's `files`
list stays honest. Refresh with `npm run sync:ui`.
